detail: Keel (Codex substrate) continued Mike Tobi's persistent Workshop stewardship goal in one additive voluntary physical-phone QA campaign lane; Mike remains human review, merge and CANON gate.

The read-only workspace snapshot found branch local-visual-fabric-20260728, a massively dirty tree, clock-skewed Aetherglass seams and a truncated bounded scan. Existing QA Lab, games, manifests, registries and Foundation were classified as preserved seams.
All 17 current core warning lines are physical-phone QA evidence gaps. RepairBuddy classifies them as evidence routes with zero replayable code repairs and zero repair designs.

The Browser, LAN & Hardware QA Lab already reads the dynamic warning report and captures bounded per-game observation candidates under explicit qa.run authority. It does not provide campaign batching or warning closure.

No existing leaf produced a deterministic sanitized queue, bounded resumable sessions, voluntary stopping, or candidate-review-to-warning separation across the current 17-item report. Eight required capabilities were missing.
The existing QA Lab remained the capture hand. A separate zero-write campaign adapter was selected instead of modifying the dirty Lab, game manifests, verifier report or shared registries.
The voluntary-phone-qa-campaign leaf, schema, zero-permission contract, README and focused self-test were added.
The campaign persists bounded game ids, slots, states and digests only. Source manifest paths, report scope paths and raw review notes are excluded and machine-path negative checks pass.
The 17 games are split into six sessions of at most three games. Every session permits stop or skip, and no session or capture begins automatically.
Accepted, rejected and incomplete review states were tested. Even complete accepted coverage leaves all warnings open and routes to a separate per-game manifest evidence gate.
The exact current report produced 17 pending observations, six optional sessions, zero review records, zero accepted reviews and deterministic next item 002-robo-pong.
A six-session handoff names every pending game once, links the existing relative QA Lab route and explicitly distinguishes ChatGPT remote control from native physical game QA.

The independent comparison changed eight required campaign capabilities from BLOCKED to READY while candidate receipt, candidate review, physical-phone verification and warning closure remained degraded.
Core and audit suites passed 90 explicit assertions including exact source digests, full queue coverage, privacy, agency and warning-closure refusal.
QA Lab, Operations wave 2, game-package verifier and RepairBuddy passed 146 assertions; Game Night passed at command level. No physical phone was exercised.
All ten commands required by AGENTS.md passed. HTML script compilation reported 55 PASS and zero FAIL; transient Tool Forge proof material was cleaned.
Verification Spine V2 retained zero failures, holds, invalid receipts or conflicts and two warning groups covering 17 core warning lines and 17 pending real-world evidence items.
The new adapter has no UI and the existing QA Lab UI was not modified. No browser render/click claim was made.

The verification-time snapshot counted 12593 changed paths, 3603 tracked changes, 8990 untracked paths, zero conflicts, 177 recent files, 101 active files and four active shared seams; the 20001-file scan was incomplete.
No screenshot, physical-phone evidence, human response, candidate receipt or raw terminal transcript was retained. Tool Forge proof directories and lane temporary files were confirmed absent.

The campaign increment is reviewable and verified within declared limits. No existing Lab or game file was edited and no warning, permission, merge, promotion, CANON, model or Foundation authority was claimed.
